facts.fact: Law 22/AN/03/5ème L of 3 August 2003 approves the national ICT development strategy and its action plan as the national policy.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Développement des TIC 2003-2013 et Plan d'Action

facts.fact: The law gives the strategy and action plan a ten-year period, 2003 to 2013.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Développement des TIC 2003-2013 et Plan d'Action

facts.fact: The law creates a National Council for guidance and follow-up of the strategy and makes the ministry in charge of ICT responsible for coordination and follow-up.
